reference.title: StorageClass
reference.shortdesc: The Red Hat Quay Operator uses the default StorageClass in your cluster to provision persistent storage for the Quay and Clair PostgreSQL databases. Ensure that your cluster has a default StorageClass configured before installation so that the Operator can create the required Persistent Volume Claims.

note.p: Before proceeding with the installation, verify that a default StorageClass is configured in your cluster to ensure that the Quay and Clair components can successfully provision their required persistent volumes.
